body: The cut potato and sample jar are tied together. an oily film coats one side; a torn strip of road tape covers the other.
title: Cut potato and sample jar, wednesday before rain
gloss: Field residue and response material meet in one ambiguous personal bundle.
rival_reading: Field workers or an emergency crew could have assembled this bundle; the mixed residue and road tape do not show which came first.

title: Last game in the margin
body: We played until a man outside told us the road would be closed at dawn. He let the other car through and said the count had been made yesterday. I kept my score sheet; it is the only record that we were here.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
